bibliographic.title: Bathroom Run
bibliographic.author: bbbbb55555
bibliographic.description:
The author recently decided to not just simply consume things but to produce creatively, after the encouragement of their friend and the success of a recent french-made JRPG.

This is a small toilet humor game as the author's first foray into interactive word-based fiction for charity.

Also NSFW for explicit language and descriptions
